issues.description: Default speaker for bulbul:v3-beta disagrees between docs ('aditya') and config ('shubh').
issues.detail: Module docstring, class docstring, README, and PR description all promise 'aditya' as the v3-beta default speaker, but TTS_MODEL_CONFIGS sets default_speaker='shubh'. Same fact represented in two places that disagree. Pick one source of truth and reconcile before merge.

issues.description: Pace bounds are complected across Pydantic Field and per-model pace_range with silent clamping.
issues.detail: InputParams declares pace with Field(ge=0.3, le=3.0), then __init__ silently clamps against a narrower per-model pace_range (e.g. 0.5-2.0 for v3). The supertype contract lies about what is accepted, and callers passing valid-by-type values get silently rewritten. Either raise or push the constraint fully into the config table.

issues.description: Unsupported-parameter detection infers caller intent by comparing to default values.
issues.detail: Code uses params.pitch != 0.0, loudness != 1.0, temperature != 0.6 to decide whether the caller 'used' an unsupported parameter. A caller explicitly passing the default gets no warning; one who omitted it cannot be distinguished from one who set it. Use model_fields_set, None sentinels, or an explicit marker.

issues.description: STT raises on unsupported params while TTS silently warns; enforcement policy is inconsistent.
issues.detail: SarvamSTTService raises ValueError for unsupported prompt/mode/language, but SarvamHttpTTSService logs a warning and silently drops pitch/loudness/temperature. Two services in the same package present opposite contracts for the same situation. Pick one substitution discipline and apply it uniformly across the Sarvam module.

issues.description: get_speakers_for_model silently falls back to v2 speakers for unknown models.
issues.detail: Unknown model names quietly return v2 speakers, hiding typos as wrong answers. The constructor already raises ValueError for unknown models; this helper should match — raise or return an empty list — so the contract is unambiguous and bugs do not travel.

issues.description: SarvamTTSModel enum and speaker enums duplicate data already in TTS_MODEL_CONFIGS.
issues.detail: The PR introduces SarvamTTSModel and SarvamTTSSpeakerV2/V3 enums, but TTS_MODEL_CONFIGS is keyed by raw strings and re-encodes the speaker lists in config.speakers. The enums become decorative labels you must keep in sync. Pick one source — key configs by the enum or drop the enums and let the data table own the registry.

synthesis.summary: The PR's central refactor — replacing substring matches on model names with a table-driven ModelConfig/TTSModelConfig — is the right direction and all three reviewers endorse it. The remaining problems cluster around parameter contracts: a v3 default speaker that disagrees between docs and config, pace bounds split across Pydantic and per-model clamping, intent inferred by comparing to default values, and inconsistent enforcement between STT (raises) and TTS (warns). Secondary cleanups: silent fallback to v2 speakers for unknown models, and decorative enums that duplicate the config table. Architectural direction is sound; finish pushing constraints into the data table and pick one validation discipline before merge.
